what: A shipping guard refused a run for a scratch file that was never actually part of what got pushed. The guard read a run's own declared-output list instead of the actual pushed diff, so a git-ignored bookkeeping file always tripped it even though it was never committed.
rule: A diff guard checks the diff, not a list of what a run merely declared.
fix: Enforcement: the guard now reads the actual pushed diff (plus anything staged) and no longer refuses a file that was never committed. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-o.test.mjs`.
